{"predictors": [
{"name": "R&D Volatility", "construction": "Calculate the standard deviation of research and development expenses over the past 5 years, scaled by total assets", "rationale": "Firms with highly volatile R&D expenses may be more likely to experience breakthroughs or setbacks, leading to higher expected returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Supply Chain Complexity", "construction": "Count the number of unique suppliers and customers reported in the firm's annual 10-K filings over the past 3 years, normalized by total revenue", "rationale": "Firms with more complex supply chains may face higher operational risks and be more likely to experience disruptions, leading to higher expected returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Employee Stock Option Concentration", "construction": "Calculate the percentage of total shares outstanding held by the top 5 executives through stock options, averaged over the past 2 years", "rationale": "Firms with highly concentrated executive ownership may be more likely to experience agency problems, leading to higher expected returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Pension Funding Status", "construction": "Calculate the funded status of the firm's pension plan as a percentage of total assets, using data from the firm's annual 10-K filings", "rationale": "Firms with underfunded pension plans may face higher expected returns due to the potential for future cash outflows", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Board Member Overcommitment", "construction": "Count the number of board members who serve on 3 or more other public company boards, normalized by total board size", "rationale": "Firms with overcommitted board members may experience weaker governance and higher expected returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Customer Concentration by Segment", "construction": "Calculate the Herfindahl index of customer concentration by business segment, using data from the firm's annual 10-K filings", "rationale": "Firms with highly concentrated customer bases may face higher risks and be more likely to experience disruptions, leading to higher expected returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Environmental Liability", "construction": "Estimate the firm's environmental liability using data from the Environmental Protection Agency's Toxic Release Inventory, scaled by total assets", "rationale": "Firms with high environmental liabilities may face higher expected returns due to the potential for future cash outflows", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Geographic Revenue Diversification", "construction": "Calculate the Herfindahl index of geographic revenue diversification, using data from the firm's annual 10-K filings", "rationale": "Firms with highly diversified geographic revenue streams may be less exposed to country-specific risks and experience lower expected returns", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": " Audit Committee Financial Expertise", "construction": "Count the! number of audit committee members with financial expertise, normalized by total audit committee size", "rationale": "Firms with audit committees lacking financial expertise may experience weaker governance and higher expected returns", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Product Lifecycle Stage", "construction": "Estimate the average product lifecycle stage using data from the firm's annual 10-K filings and industry reports, scaled by total revenue", "rationale": "Firms with products in the growth stage of their lifecycle may experience higher expected returns due to the potential for future growth", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}
]}
